message: 僕らの学園は戦場だった

name: Nanaka
message: 「Anyway, 'Stumbling Fools in Love' has had a crazy plot twist, hasn't it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What is that?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's amazing. It's a drama where you totally can't predict what's coming next. Just last week, I thought Miyuki-chan was a handsome boy, and it turned out she was actually a gorgeous girl!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoho~~. I don't really get it, but it sounds amazing.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn only hears the plot from me and doesn't know the cast, so... I'm jealous, the surprises hit way harder for him.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun really is the type to get impressed easily by things, isn't he?」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, that means he has a good personality that can find the good in anything.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan is so kind! Share some of that kindness with yours truly, please.」

name: Misa
message: 「What's wrong? Ah.」

name: Ria
message: 「...Something feels weird.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Things are stirring.」

name: Synn
message: 「Demons... but where are they?」
I can't tell the direction. I feel the presence of magical power from all around.
Could it be!?

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister! It is dangerous here! Leave the rest to me and please flee!」

name: Shio
message: 「Foul spirits are swarming the academy! Therefore--」

name: Sally
message: 「Hiya~」

name: Shio
message: 「Show yourself, foul spirit! Showing up here so brazenly seals your fate--mgghhh!」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't just start swinging your naginata around like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan. Did you see any demons?」

name: Sally
message: 「They're all over the place. Hey, what's about to start? How exciting.」

name: Shio
message: 「Begone, vile--mmph, mmph!」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen, Shio. She's on our side.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, Jiiya. Yes. Understood!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Principal!」

name: Helena
message: 「'Was it you who called for me?'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, it was!」

name: Helena
message: 「I heard the details from Tamiko. Understood, I grant permission to enter the airspace above the academy.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's a report from Jiiya. He says there are numerous hostile presences inside the academy.」

name: Misa
message: 「What do you mean by that!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just now, when Jiiya looked down at the academy from the sky, he spotted a large number of demons.」

name: Synn
message: 「Specifically, how many」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How many are there? Th-There are that many of them!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Could it be... around 30?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He says there are over 50.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「F-Fifty!? That's seriously bad!」

name: Ria
message: 「Fifty demons that strong...」

name: Paqy
message: 「We're in a tight spot.」
For some reason, I found myself thinking it was a good thing Azel wasn't here.

name: Misa
message: 「We have no choice but to barricade ourselves in here and intercept them.」

name: Shio
message: 「Offense is the greatest defense, indeed. Pay no heed to the consequences, simply charge! I, too, shall rush to your aid from this moment forth!」
Shio joined the party!!

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte. Ask Riesling about the demons' formation.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, right. Jiiya, how are the demons positioned?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He says over ten units are deployed surrounding this area.」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Moreover, he says he'll continue to rush in as backup from here on out.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's reassuring! Let's go, everyone!」
Riesling joined the party too!!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah! I'm an Edokko through and through! Holing up ain't my style!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Justice will prevail.」

name: Misa
message: 「We probably wouldn't win by holing up either, sure, but this is way too reckless!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn. Can you tell?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. Most likely.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I see how it is.」
Despite all their grumbling, everyone transforms and comes along with me.

name: Sally
message: 「It's been ages since we had a flashy brawl like this! I'm so excited!」

name: Shio
message: 「This humble one shall take the vanguard.」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio. You're our ultimate weapon, so stay in the back.」

name: Shio
message: 「Ooh! Has Elder Sister finally recognized this one's true strength?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, is he gullible.」

name: Helena
message: 「I used the PA system to evacuate the students and staff inside the buildings. Go wild.」
Riding the momentum, even Helena joined the party!!

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much.」

name: Misa
message: 「...You sound like you actually have some kind of plan.」

name: Synn
message: 「We're going to strike the enemy commander directly.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To shoot the prize, first shoot the gross horse, right?」

name: Shio
message: 「It is 'To shoot the general, first shoot his horse,' I say!」

name: Synn
message: 「Among all these magical signatures, the commander will be wherever the biggest, strongest one is.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's that supposed to mean? I was just about to think of that myself!」

name: Synn
message: 「We'll break through before the enemy can surround us.」
We dash straight through the old school building and burst out into the plaza.
The strongest magical signature is......

name: Synn
message: 「Over there!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't that Finis Tower」

name: Synn
message: 「We're charging straight there on the shortest route」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa. It's the Demons!」

name: Cat Demon
message: 「Meow!」
